indicator_name: Oil and condensate production by KMG asset (KMG share; Tengiz, Kashagan and Karachaganak also at 100 %) and crude transportation by pipeline operator, quarterly
description: Добыча нефти и конденсата по активам КМГ (в доле КМГ; Тенгиз, Кашаган и Карачаганак также в 100 %) и транспортировка нефти по операторам трубопроводов, поквартально
methodology: KazMunayGas quarterly databook (sheets «стр. 6», «стр. 7»), 2015 Q1 onward. Production items are KMG's equity share; TCO_GROSS = TCO / 0.20, KPO_GROSS = KPO / 0.10, NCOC_GROSS = NCOC / 0.0844 (to 2022 Q2) or / 0.1688 (from 2022 Q4; 2022 Q3 skipped). 2025: Tengiz 39.0 mln t (KMG share 7 802.2 kt), Kashagan 17.9 mln t, Karachaganak 10.9 mln t. TRANSPORT_KTO / _KCP / _MUNAITAS / _CPC (CPC on the basis of KMG's share) / _BATUMI, million tonnes; SHARE_EXPORT / _TRANSIT / _DOMESTIC of pipeline transport, %. Field-level monthly output and crude exports by route (CPC, Atyrau-Samara, Atasu-Alashankou) are published only in Ministry of Energy and KazTransOil press texts and are not connected; oil output by region (Atyrau = Tengiz + Kashagan, West Kazakhstan = Karachaganak) is in INDUSTRY_PRODUCTION_PHYSICAL_BY_REGION_MONTHLY.
